final.answer: Updated Dispatcher.java to centralize all dispatcher-to-subscriber handoffs through a shared helper. The helper invokes exactly one no-op recordDispatcherToSubscriberHandoff hook immediately before subscriber.dispatchEvent(event), while all three dispatcher strategies use the shared handoff path. No hook was added at EventBus.post, queue insertion, or inside Subscriber.dispatchEvent.
